settings.damageNumbers.title: Damage numbers
settings.damageNumbers.description: Classic is the original short yellow number. Cascade keeps numbers up longer, stacks them above each enemy, and shifts color and size as hits get bigger. Display only; never changes damage.
settings.title: Settings
settings.subtitle: Controls & accessibility
settings.language.title: Language
settings.language.description: Pick a language, or leave this on Match my device to follow your browser or phone language, including when you change it. Translations are made automatically, so some wording may be off, and anything not translated yet stays in English. This device only.
settings.fightStyle.title: Travel fight style
settings.fightStyle.description: How a travel encounter plays out. Classic is the original card-throw popup. The other three use your lead LokPet on the arena engine, and their layout adapts to your screen. This device only.
settings.fightStyle.classic.label: Classic
settings.fightStyle.classic.blurb: The original card-throw popup. Throw a Battle Deck card or a punch.
settings.fightStyle.quick.label: Quick
settings.fightStyle.quick.blurb: Your lead LokPet, three moves, at most eight rounds, next enemy move shown.
settings.fightStyle.duo.label: Duo
settings.fightStyle.duo.blurb: Operator and LokPet fight together: pick a LokPet move and an operator assist every round. Bring your selected team and swap LokPets mid-fight.
settings.fightStyle.arena.label: Arena
settings.fightStyle.arena.blurb: The full battle: every move including finishers, Cheer, up to twenty rounds. Bring your selected team and swap LokPets mid-fight.

fight.switch.title: Switch LokPet
fight.switch.hint: Costs your turn. The opponent still strikes.
hideout.prop.bell-cord.label: Bell cord
hideout.prop.bell-cord.line.1: You give the cord a tug. Somewhere, a tip jar jingles.
hideout.prop.relay-crate.label: Relay Crate
hideout.prop.relay-crate.line.1: The crate hums as it passes along whatever was left for you.
hideout.prop.relay-crate.line.2: Someone keeps restocking it. You decide not to ask who.
hideout.prop.relay-crate.rare: A false bottom! A LokPet treat is wedged under the packing.
hideout.prop.window-seat.label: Window seat
hideout.prop.window-seat.line.1: You sit a while. The block looks smaller from up here.
hideout.prop.window-seat.line.2: A bus goes by, every window lit and empty.
hideout.prop.window-seat.line.3: For a minute, nothing needs you. It helps.
hideout.prop.fire-escape-stash.label: Fire-escape stash
hideout.prop.fire-escape-stash.line.1: A loose grate, a taped-up bag. Someone trusts you with this.
hideout.prop.fire-escape-stash.line.2: You check the street, then the stash. Quick and quiet.
hideout.prop.fire-escape-stash.rare: Taped under the grate: a sealed elixir vial.
hideout.prop.stoop-cat.label: Stoop cat
hideout.prop.stoop-cat.line.1: The cat watches you with total, bored authority.
hideout.prop.stoop-cat.line.2: It slow-blinks. That is as close to a greeting as you get.
hideout.prop.beacon-lamp.label: Beacon Lamp
hideout.prop.beacon-lamp.line.1: You trim the wick. The Beacon Lamp throws a warm circle over the roof.
hideout.prop.beacon-lamp.line.2: Lit for whoever is still out there. Someone left a tip in the dish.
hideout.prop.old-telescope.label: Old telescope
hideout.prop.old-telescope.line.1: The brass is cold. The lens is clear. The sky is up to something.
hideout.prop.old-telescope.line.2: You squint through it. Rooftops, water towers, one very still pigeon.
hideout.prop.static-jar.label: Static Jar
hideout.prop.static-jar.line.1: The Static Jar fizzes. A few coins' worth of sparks drift to the bottom.
hideout.prop.static-jar.line.2: You tap the glass. It tingles. Good luck, probably.
hideout.prop.static-jar.rare: The jar crackles and coughs up a card credit chip.
hideout.prop.luvitnot-keeper.label: Armory keeper
hideout.prop.luvitnot-keeper.line.1: The keeper tilts their glass helmet. "The Armory is open to you."
hideout.prop.luvitnot-keeper.line.2: "Take what you need. Return what you borrow."
hideout.prop.pulse-jukebox.label: Pulse Jukebox
hideout.prop.pulse-jukebox.line.1: The Pulse Jukebox warms up with a low, patient hum.
hideout.prop.pulse-jukebox.line.2: It flickers through your tracks, hunting for one that fits the room.
hideout.life.eventChipAria: Something is happening nearby. Tap to see.
hideout.life.stripAria: Your operator and LokPets in the hideout. Tap the ground or press the left and right arrow keys to walk. Tap a prop to use it.
hideout.life.stripAriaPlain: Your operator and LokPets in the hideout.
settings.hideout.walk.title: Walk and props
settings.hideout.walk.description: Walk your operator with taps or the arrow keys, and use the props around each room.
settings.hideout.play.title: Pet play
settings.hideout.play.description: A row of things to do with your LokPet under the strip: scratch, fetch, nap together and more.
settings.hideout.choice.title: Choice events
settings.hideout.choice.description: Now and then something comes up while you move around, and you decide what to do. Never forced on you.
settings.crewTalk.title: Crew chatter
settings.crewTalk.description: What your rescued crew say when you walk up to them in a room.
settings.crewTalk.toneDescription: Family keeps it warm and gentle. Wry adds drier, more grown-up humor. Both stay fine for a child to read.
settings.hideout.notice.title: Note duration
settings.hideout.notice.description: How long the notes in the hideout corner stay up before fading.
hideout.care.scratch.label: Scratch
hideout.care.scratch.hint: Behind the ears. Shy and sleepy pets love it.
hideout.care.scratch.loved: {{pet}} melts into your hand and will not let you stop.
hideout.care.scratch.liked: {{pet}} leans in and holds still for it.
hideout.care.scratch.meh: {{pet}} puts up with it, then wanders off.
hideout.care.fetch.label: Fetch
hideout.care.fetch.hint: A quick dash. Bouncy and bold pets live for it.
hideout.care.fetch.loved: {{pet}} streaks off and is back before you finish throwing.
hideout.care.fetch.liked: {{pet}} fetches it, then looks at you for another.
hideout.care.fetch.meh: {{pet}} watches the toy land, then looks at you like you did that.
hideout.care.boogie.label: Boogie
hideout.care.boogie.hint: Needs music playing. Bouncy pets cannot help themselves.
hideout.care.boogie.loved: {{pet}} loses it completely. Four spins and a hop, all on the beat.
hideout.care.boogie.meh: {{pet}} sways a little. That is a lot, for them.
hideout.care.snack-break.label: Snack break
hideout.care.snack-break.hint: Share a bite on the stoop. Chill pets savor it.
hideout.care.snack-break.loved: {{pet}} makes it last, one slow bite at a time.
hideout.care.snack-break.liked: {{pet}} polishes off its share and checks yours.
hideout.care.snack-break.meh: {{pet}} eats fast and looks around for more.
hideout.care.nap-together.label: Nap together
hideout.care.nap-together.hint: Evenings and nights. Sleepy pets take it very seriously.
hideout.care.nap-together.loved: {{pet}} curls up against you and is asleep in seconds.
hideout.care.nap-together.liked: {{pet}} settles in beside you for a while.
hideout.care.sniff-hunt.label: Sniff hunt
hideout.care.sniff-hunt.hint: Needs a Familiar bond. Your pet sniffs out whatever the block lost.
hideout.care.sniff-hunt.loved: {{pet}} follows a scent straight to something worth finding.
hideout.care.sniff-hunt.liked: {{pet}} sniffs around and turns something up.
hideout.care.sniff-hunt.meh: {{pet}} sniffs, sneezes, and finds a little something anyway.
hideout.care.sniff-hunt.rare: {{pet}} digs a sealed elixir vial out from behind a pipe!
hideout.play.title: Play with {{pet}}
hideout.event.stray-at-the-door.title: Stray at the door
hideout.event.stray-at-the-door.body: A thin stray is sitting by the door, watching you with one ear up.
hideout.event.stray-at-the-door.o.feed.1: It eats, then leaves something shiny on the step.
hideout.event.stray-at-the-door.o.feed.2: It eats and trots off. A fair trade.
hideout.event.stray-at-the-door.o.feed.3: It drops a LokPet treat at your feet, like a thank-you.
hideout.event.stray-at-the-door.o.shoo.1: It slinks off. The doorway feels a little colder.
hideout.event.stray-at-the-door.o.pet.1: {{pet}} sniffs once, then lets the stray stay close. You both feel better for it.
hideout.event.stray-at-the-door.o.pet.2: {{pet}} trades a long look with the stray and comes back looking proud.
hideout.event.dropped-satchel.title: Dropped satchel
hideout.event.dropped-satchel.body: Someone's satchel is sitting on a step, zipped shut. Nobody is around.
hideout.event.dropped-satchel.o.open.1: A few crumpled bills and a gum wrapper. Better than nothing.
hideout.event.dropped-satchel.o.open.2: Mostly receipts. You keep one for the doodle on the back.
hideout.event.dropped-satchel.o.open.3: Tucked in the lining: a card credit chip.
hideout.event.dropped-satchel.c.hand-in: Hand it in at the GRPD desk
The desk sergeant nods. A day later, a thank-you note and a few cred turn up.
hideout.event.dropped-satchel.o.sniff.1: {{pet}} nudges the zip open with a paw. Nothing dangerous, just spare cred.
hideout.event.dropped-satchel.o.sniff.2: {{pet}} sneezes and loses interest. You open it yourself: nothing.
hideout.event.busker-on-the-corner.title: Busker on the corner
hideout.event.busker-on-the-corner.body: Someone is playing a battered keyboard on the corner, with a hat out and no one stopping.
hideout.event.busker-on-the-corner.o.lis: You stay for the whole song. Walking on, you feel lighter.
hideout.event.busker-on-the-corner.o.req: They play it. The whole block hums along.
They do not know it, but they play something better.
hideout.event.busker-on-the-corner.o.joi: You keep time on an upturned bucket. Strangers clap.
You miss every beat. Strangers clap anyway.
hideout.event.rooftop-flare.title: A light past the water towers
hideout.event.rooftop-flare.body: Past the water towers, a thin light rises and winks out.
hideout.event.rooftop-flare.o.follow.1: You track it to a rooftop garden. Someone waves.
hideout.event.rooftop-flare.o.follow.2: Just a drone doing laps. Still a good view.
hideout.event.rooftop-flare.o.follow.3: A tiny canister drifts down on a scrap of parachute. Inside: a sealed elixir vial.
hideout.event.rooftop-flare.o.log.1: The notebook fills up. You feel like you know the sky a little better.
hideout.event.rooftop-flare.o.wave.1: The light blinks twice. Somebody was waiting for that.
hideout.event.rooftop-flare.o.wave.2: Nothing answers. But for a second you felt seen.
hideout.event.pigeon-census.title: Pigeon census
hideout.event.pigeon-census.body: Through the telescope, one very still pigeon is staring straight back at you.
hideout.event.pigeon-census.o.count.1: Forty-one pigeons, give or take. You write it down like it matters.
hideout.event.pigeon-census.o.salute.1: It bobs once. You are almost sure that was respect.
hideout.event.pigeon-census.o.salute.2: It leaves. Rude, and a little impressive.
hideout.event.leaking-pipe.title: Leaking pipe
hideout.event.leaking-pipe.body: A pipe on the cellar ceiling is dripping something faintly bright into a puddle.
hideout.event.leaking-pipe.o.patch.1: A strip of tape and a lot of grumbling. The drip stops, and someone leaves a few cred in thanks.
hideout.event.leaking-pipe.o.patch.2: The tape will not hold. You mop up and move on.
hideout.event.leaking-pipe.o.collect.1: A jar's worth of something that fizzes. The jars seem to like it.
hideout.event.leaking-pipe.o.collect.2: The jar fills with static, and a card credit pings into it.
hideout.event.leaking-pipe.o.leave.1: Drip. Drip. Drip. You will hear it in your sleep.
hideout.event.lost-leash.title: A lost leash
hideout.event.lost-leash.body: A bright red leash is lying across the sidewalk, one end still clipped to a lamppost.
hideout.event.lost-leash.o.return.1: You find them two blocks over, frantic. They press a few cred on you.
hideout.event.lost-leash.o.return.2: Nobody is looking for it. You leave it hooked on the lamppost, where it can be found.
hideout.event.lost-leash.o.keep.1: It is a good leash. Nobody comes asking. You feel slightly strange about it.
hideout.event.lost-leash.o.ask.1: {{pet}} sniffs the leash, then the air, then points you the right way. Everyone ends up happy.
hideout.event.pet-dream.title: A restless sleeper
hideout.event.pet-dream.body: {{pet}} twitches in its sleep, paws moving like it is running somewhere far away.
hideout.event.pet-dream.o.wake.1: {{pet}} blinks up at you, a little confused, and leans in.
hideout.event.pet-dream.o.dream.1: Whatever it saw, {{pet}} wakes up lighter.
hideout.event.pet-dream.o.sit.1: {{pet}} wakes, finds you right there, and does not move for a long time.
hideout.event.pet-dream.o.sit.2: {{pet}} presses something into your hand when it wakes: a sealed elixir vial.
hideout.event.long-way-round.title: The long way round
hideout.event.long-way-round.body: You have wandered a while. The block looks different from here.
hideout.event.long-way-round.o.long.1: You find a coin wedged in a drain. Good luck, probably.
hideout.event.long-way-round.o.long.2: Nothing happens. It was still a good walk.
hideout.event.long-way-round.o.short.1: Quick and quiet. You are home before the kettle clicks off.
hideout.event.long-way-round.o.short.2: A cat glares at you from a bin. You back out slowly.
hideout.event.long-way-round.o.follow.1: {{pet}} leads you to a spot with a view. You both sit and watch the street.
hideout.event.long-way-round.o.follow.2: {{pet}} leads you in a circle and looks extremely pleased with itself.
hideout.event.ui.fizzle: You almost found something special, but the moment slips away. You still come away with a little.
sleeve.title: Sleeve Counter
sleeve.intro: Dress up your LokPacks. Wrappers, card backs and card frames are cosmetic only: they never change pack odds, prices or card stats.
sleeve.motion.label: Card motion
sleeve.kind.packSkin.hint: How the packs on the counter look.
sleeve.kind.cardBack.hint: Shown face-down while you open a pack.
sleeve.kind.cardFrame.hint: How your collected cards are laid out and bordered.
settings.cardMotion.title: Card motion
settings.cardMotion.body: Pack wrappers, card backs and card frames can tilt toward your cursor and shimmer. Full does both, Subtle only reacts when you hover, Off keeps everything still. Devices set to reduce motion stay still automatically.
forge.style.label: Look
forge.style.classicHint: Classic v1 uses the original plain operator build. Your detailed v2 features are kept and come back when you switch.
forge.variants.enemiesIntro: Classic enemies as they appear in a run. Recolor one and save it as a custom look. Stats and behavior never change.
forge.variants.petsIntro: Classic LokPets with their original silhouettes. Recolor one and save it as a custom look. Abilities and stats never change.
forge.variants.full: Saved list is full. Delete one to make room.
